newsitem.title: USA: Orange Cty bankruptcy suits sent to district court.
newsitem.headline: Orange Cty bankruptcy suits sent to district court.

text.p: Orange County's major bankruptcy-related lawsuits against investment firms and others will all be heard in federal district court rather than Bankruptcy Court, a county attorney said Thursday.

The California county agreed to move its lawsuits against Morgan Stanley Group Inc, LeBoeuf Lamb Greene & MacRae and Fuji Securities Inc, a unit of Fuji Bank Ltd, into the district court, county attorney Michael Swartz said.
The agreements were reached following a court decision moving the county's other bankruptcy-related suits.

In October, U.S. District Judge Gary Taylor granted motions by Merrill Lynch & Co, Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae), KPMG Peat Marwick LLP, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc and McGraw-Hill Cos Inc's Standard & Poor's Corp to move the county complaints to district court.
The county filed for bankruptcy protection Dec 6, 1994, after sustaining losses of more than $1.6 billion on risky investments. The county emerged from bankruptcy last June.
